root_cause: The first roll-forward protocol bounded SSE queries by SSEDATE to the signal-minus-120-day calendar window. Because the official current-enumeration response can retain an older SSEDATE while exposing a later ADDDATE, that query domain could omit a record whose conservative causal knowledge time falls in a later candidate window.
correction_timing: The defect was found after official metadata collection but before any 2022-2026 title projection, title classification, selector result, performance statistic, or Stage-B outcome join.

pre_stage_schema_diagnostic.purpose: verify the frozen bridge schema and runner contract checks only
pre_stage_schema_diagnostic.checks: 15-field selected/outcome exact join, alpha=0.67, horizon=20, stop=NONE, completion evidence, maximum exit date 2026-09-02
pre_stage_schema_diagnostic.scientific_consequence: The parent outcomes were already consumed by the V28 family and this diagnostic additionally opened their bytes before Stage A; no period in this roll-forward is claimed to be untouched pristine OOS. Stage A itself remains outcome-content-blind.

preseal_build_recovery.failure: The first wrapper build persisted only announcement_route_index.parquet and then raised KeyError because the builder attempted to read source counts from the nested sealer validation return instead of the already sealed source manifests.
preseal_build_recovery.recovery: After confirming the exact path, regular-file type, read-only mode, hash, and absence of activation_audit.json and asset_manifest.json, only this unsealed partial file was made writable and unlinked; the wrapper exact-top returned to the four pre-build members.
preseal_build_recovery.recoverability: The deleted partial bytes are not retained, but the route is deterministically reproducible from the intact sealed sources, exact parent selected identity, and frozen software; the rebuilt route hash must match or validation fails.

unchanged_rule.window: signal_time minus 120 calendar days <= causal_available_at <= signal_time
unchanged_rule.admit: zero V2-classified explicit OPEN issuer-fact titles in the inclusive window
unchanged_rule.execution: first legal post-signal minute open, A67 target, H20 clock, 20 bp per side, K80 per Main/ChiNext sleeve

knowledge_time.SSE: max(original ADDDATE, SSEDATE plus 1 calendar day 00:00 Asia/Shanghai)
knowledge_time.SZSE: source-second publishTime; date-only or midnight publishTime plus 1 calendar day 00:00 Asia/Shanghai
knowledge_time.evidence_grade: PIT-B current official enumeration; historical deletion and revision vintages are incomplete

superseded_protocol_document.reason: Its single 2021-10-18 query-start declaration is insufficient for SSEDATE membership and its software hashes predate routed-source correction. It is retained unchanged for audit but cannot authorize Stage A.
